name: Goa
description: Sun-soaked beaches, buzzing beach shacks and a nightlife that never sleeps make Goa India's favourite coastal escape.

name: Manali
description: Snow-capped peaks, apple orchards and the thrill of Solang Valley make Manali a classic Himalayan getaway.

name: Shimla
description: Colonial architecture, pine-clad hills and the toy train make Shimla the queen of hill stations.

name: Jaipur
description: The Pink City dazzles with majestic forts, royal palaces and vibrant bazaars steeped in Rajput history.

name: Udaipur
description: Serene lakes, floating palaces and romantic sunsets earn Udaipur its title as the City of Lakes.

name: Alleppey
description: Palm-fringed backwaters and traditional houseboats offer one of India's most tranquil experiences.

name: Munnar
description: Rolling tea plantations and misty hills make Munnar a refreshing escape into green tranquility.

name: Rishikesh
description: The Yoga Capital of the World blends spiritual calm on the Ganges with adrenaline-pumping river rafting.

name: Varanasi
description: Ancient ghats, evening aartis and centuries of unbroken tradition make Varanasi India's spiritual heart.

name: Agra
description: Home to the timeless Taj Mahal, Agra is a monument to Mughal artistry and eternal love.

name: Leh-Ladakh
description: High-altitude deserts, turquoise lakes and monastery-dotted mountains make Ladakh a bucket-list adventure.

name: Darjeeling
description: Tea gardens, toy trains and views of Kanchenjunga make Darjeeling a fragrant Himalayan retreat.

name: Gangtok
description: Monasteries, mountain views and Himalayan culture blend seamlessly in Sikkim's charming capital.

name: Port Blair
description: Turquoise waters, coral reefs and pristine beaches make the Andamans India's tropical paradise.

name: Coorg
description: Coffee estates, waterfalls and misty hills make Coorg the Scotland of India.

name: Ooty
description: Rolling nilgiri hills, botanical gardens and a toy train ride make Ooty a nostalgic hill escape.

name: Mysore
description: Grand palaces, silk sarees and royal legacy make Mysore a majestic cultural stop.

name: Hampi
description: Sprawling boulder-strewn ruins of the Vijayanagara Empire make Hampi an open-air history museum.

name: Pushkar
description: A holy lake, camel fairs and a laid-back bazaar give Pushkar its unmistakable mystic charm.

name: Jaisalmer
description: Golden sand dunes and a sandstone fort make Jaisalmer a mesmerizing desert adventure.

name: Jodhpur
description: The Blue City is dominated by the majestic Mehrangarh Fort towering over indigo-washed streets.

name: Shillong
description: Living root bridges, waterfalls and rolling clouds make Shillong the Scotland of the East.

name: Kaziranga National Park
description: Home to the one-horned rhinoceros, Kaziranga offers thrilling jeep and elephant safaris.

name: Ranthambore National Park
description: Dense forests and royal ruins make Ranthambore one of India's best tiger-spotting destinations.

name: Mumbai
description: The city that never sleeps mixes Bollywood glamour, colonial landmarks and buzzing street food.

name: Delhi
description: Mughal monuments, colonial avenues and street food markets converge in India's dynamic capital.

name: Kolkata
description: Colonial architecture, literary heritage and legendary street food define the City of Joy.

name: Pondicherry
description: French colonial streets meet quiet beaches in this pastel-hued coastal town.

name: Rann of Kutch
description: A shimmering white salt desert that transforms into a moonlit wonderland during the Rann Utsav.

name: Nainital
description: A pretty lake town ringed by forested hills, perfect for a relaxed Himalayan family holiday.

name: Spiti Valley
description: A cold desert of monasteries and moonscapes, Spiti is the ultimate off-beat Himalayan adventure.

name: Amritsar
description: The golden glow of the Golden Temple and the electric Wagah Border ceremony define Amritsar.
